gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: 本課程以議題單元方式，引導學生探索內容，於班級活動課程中依單元性質，進行測評、問卷、訪談、或心得報告等作法，以了解學生單元學習情形，並將結果回饋相關課程進行後續之課程學習成效評估。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be achieved by maintaining mutual dignity and mutual respect among classmates and teachers. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by each other's classroom behavior rules, and get used to a culture of politeness.
1.	Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
2.	All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
3.	Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. 
4.	You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
5.	Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
6.	Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent.
7.	Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
Thank you for your cooperation!
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: I hope that all students can complete various learning tasks according to the teaching progress, participate in various learning activities in a regular and active manner, hand in homework on time, complete various learning tasks, and meet the learning objectives of this course. Get the grades you deserve. If you encounter learning difficulties during the school semester, please make good use of my benefit time, or make another appointment with me to seek improvement solutions together. Classes invite students to form learning communities to review before exams, including tips from former students who have been successful in the course.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
對於剛上大學的新生來說   不管事考試還是報告  未來的新型式會更多元  
在資訊爆炸與快速變遷的情況下   需要給予學生  基本的學術誠信認知相關知識   
1. 如何正確地引用資料出處  而不會造成抄襲問題  
2. 提醒同學  如何不抄襲其他同學的作業 或報告等  
Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. In all your work, you may cite words or ideas written by others in publications, websites, or other sources, provided you cite the source. Original work is my bottom line, plagiarized work will receive a "0" or "fail" score. If you are repeat offenders, you will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
